caption: The drawing consists of a central wrought iron gate flanked by two matching fence panels, all rendered in black lines with gray-blue shading to suggest shadows and depth. The gate features vertical bars, two decorative vases with scrolling handles, and diamond and loop motifs in the lower panels. At the top of the gate, an arched design supports a tall central cross, embellished with radiating lines and curved elements. Behind the fence and to the right, a stone post with a rounded urn stands against a vague, lightly sketched architectural background. The main composition is framed by a single line rectangle. In the upper left corner, there is a small, separate drawing of a rosette with a circular floral design and ribbon-like elements. In the upper right corner, another boxed detail shows an ornate cross form with rounded ends and incised lines, also in gray tones. The background and surrounding page are a light cream color, with the drawing composed in monochrome grays and blacks.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
